info.name: The Existence of the Secret Organization

descriptions.notStarted: #b#m260000000##k is famous for producing #t4011008#, but the people of #m260000000# don't seem to be wealthy, and that's because of the queen... Maybe #b#p2101000##k, who dances in the middle of the town, knows a thing or two about the queen.
descriptions.inProgress: When I asked #p2101000# about the queen, she started complaining about the queen's lack of humanity, and mentioned #bSand Bandits#k in the process. Apparently, Sand Bandits steal the treasures of the greedy queen and give them to the struggling folks in this town, all done in a secretive manner. A good thief? Not bad. When I told her I was interested in joining Sand Bandits, #p2101000# thought about it for a while and told me if I can find #bthe wall that has something written about Sand Bandits#k, then I may be able to find them. I better find the wall and then return to #b#p2101000##k.
descriptions.completed: I found the wall that had the symbolism of Sand Bandits written on. When I looked closer, there seems to be a clue on the Sand Bandits... A dagger, an iron hammer, a bow, an arrow? What does that mean?
